request: 配置 Port 引脚复用，PA0 为 GPIO 输出，PA1 为 ADC 输入
config:
```yaml
Port:
  PortPin:
    - id: 0
      name: PA0
      direction: OUTPUT
      initial_level: LOW
      slew_rate: MEDIUM
    - id: 1
      name: PA1
      direction: INPUT
      adc_channel: 1
      pull_resistor: NONE
```

request: 配置 8 个 GPIO 引脚，4 输入 4 输出
config:
```yaml
Port:
  general:
    dev_error_detect: true
  PortPin:
    - id: 0
      name: PA0
      direction: OUTPUT
      initial_level: LOW
    - id: 1
      name: PA1
      direction: OUTPUT
      initial_level: LOW
    - id: 2
      name: PA2
      direction: OUTPUT
      initial_level: LOW
    - id: 3
      name: PA3
      direction: OUTPUT
      initial_level: LOW
    - id: 4
      name: PA4
      direction: INPUT
      pull_resistor: PULL_UP
    - id: 5
      name: PA5
      direction: INPUT
      pull_resistor: PULL_UP
    - id: 6
      name: PA6
      direction: INPUT
      pull_resistor: PULL_DOWN
    - id: 7
      name: PA7
      direction: INPUT
      pull_resistor: PULL_DOWN
```
